digest.component_or_area: agent tooling and guidance (Serena symbol tools, Bash grep hook)
propositions: Agents enumerate source-code references by hand with grep despite documentation preferring Serena symbol tools because the cheap tool wins under friction asymmetry (grep requires no discovery; Serena symbol tools are deferred behind ToolSearch)

Serena's LSP cannot resolve symbols referenced as string literals (e.g., monkeypatch.setattr, getattr, importlib calls), causing agents who follow the preference exclusively to miss real call sites that fail CI

The guidance must encode the division of labour between tools rather than state a bare preference: Serena for structural call-graph lookup, grep for string-literal sites and current-tree line numbers after edits (LSP index lag)
A PreToolUse hook on Bash must surface a non-blocking reminder on every grep invocation, naming both the preferred path and the legitimate exception, to re-surface the tool at moment of action
Project-overlay criteria and coaching moves must direct re-derivation via Serena when code review finds source-code references were enumerated by hand or incompletely
Serena symbol tools must require no ToolSearch discovery step (env.ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH pinned in .claude/settings.json) to eliminate friction asymmetry
